**Verified branch:** Spilka beer & restaurant, **Legionárska 8, Bratislava** — the site’s “Ponuka” page lists this address and its **DENNÉ MENU** link opens the lunch-menu PDF used below. ([spilkarestaurant.sk](https://www.spilkarestaurant.sk/ponuka/))

**Menu date establishing validity:** the PDF is headed **“DENNÉ MENU”** and dated **“12. 10. – 16. 10. 2026 • PODÁVAME 11:00 – 14:00”**. The requested date, **2026-10-12**, is covered by this range and corresponds to the **PONDELOK** section. ([spilkarestaurant.sk](https://www.spilkarestaurant.sk/261012-spilka_menu_12-16_10_2026/))
